# Deck

## What the cards share

Every card is a Titan Warrior close to the enemy: Blood Hunt lunges and consumes the bleed, Rolling Slam crushes a pack, or a unique deals the damage around you.

## How they differ

Three lead with Blood Hunt, one with Rolling Slam, and one with a unique item instead of a skill.

## Round 1

- r1-a-1 "Blood Hunt bleed burst" | one lunge spends the bleed you built for a big hit, so rares melt in two presses
- r1-a-2 "Rolling Slam aftershocks" | Rolling Slam with aftershocks hits a pack twice for one press
- r1-c-1 "Melting Maelstrom nova" | a unique that deals its own damage around you, so you just walk into packs | under-played (judgment: an item-effect damage source, which few builds lead with) | can't be finalized yet: its damage source isn't a skill
- r1-c-2 "Rolling Slam block tank" | a shield and block keep you standing while the slam does the work | under-played (judgment: a block shape few slam builds take)
- r1-c-3 "Blood Hunt rage cycling" | rage builds while you fight and spends itself on bigger lunges

## Not dealt

- r1-a-3 "Blood Hunt crit lunge" | no lookup confirms "critical hits inflict Blood Loss"
- r1-b-1 "Blood Hunt on a two-hander" | no lookup confirms "a two-handed spear grants Blood Hunt's reach"
- r1-b-2 "Blood Hunt armour stacker" | no lookup confirms "armour adds to Blood Hunt's damage"
- r1-b-3 "Blood Hunt with a bleed unique" | the same build as "Blood Hunt bleed burst"
